rate_distortion_verdict_note: Expected for Gate 1: only the frozen arm was pre-registered. incomplete-sweep means the dual-arm rate-distortion criterion cannot adjudicate retain/kill; Gate 1 uses the separate rate-axis gate.

gate_1.rule: Gate 1 passes iff spearman(alpha, rate) <= -0.8 AND rate_span >= 0.3 AND rate_span materially larger than the 7-route baseline. Failing means fix posterior variance parameterization; do NOT proceed to Stage 2 pretraining.
